en: Color aerial-style view of a lakeside town nestled in a green valley with terraced fields and dense forests, bordered by steep mountains and rocky alpine peaks in the background. The calm blue lake dominates the foreground, with the town stretching along the shoreline and up the lower slopes. A winding road runs along the hillside on the right. The architecture appears European, with compact low-rise buildings and at least one tall church bell tower. No visible caption or printed text is present on the front.
